text:
marta-ps: Quick heads-up 10am PT pilot with AstraLedger next week. They tunnel a single HTTP/2 connection and want to multiplex ~200 logical streams. Main asks: a Python mux snippet, a curl fallback, consistent telemetry labels for their APM, ephemeral token rotation guidance, and SOC2 questionnaire turnaround.

kevin-sales: Demo Tue 2pm PT. They start on Hosted but may request Dedicated if spikes look problematic. Need a 1-page ops runbook we can hand to their infra team.

sam-runtime: Python mux minimal example (sync streaming):
```py
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), enable_mux=True)
# open logical stream 1
stream = client.stream(model='gpt-4o-mini', stream_id='astra-01', trace=True)
for chunk in stream:
    print('payload', chunk)
# open additional logical streams reusing same transport
stream2 = client.stream(model='gpt-4o-mini', stream_id='astra-02')
```
Fallback (simple HTTP request):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

sam-runtime: If their proxy strips upgrade headers, set transport_hint: "http2-proxy" so we use header-based muxing. Fallback plan: open short-lived independent connections per logical stream or use batch non-streaming calls.

hana-devex: Telemetry tags we suggest per logical stream: service=astraledger, env=pilot, stream_id, tenant_id, demo_tag. Recommend they add x-trace-id to correlate with their APM. We can auto-ingest when trace:true is set on the stream.

hana-devex: For function/tool calling and structured output, here's a tiny contract we demo so they can validate parsing: 
```json
{"name":"sanitize_payment","params":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_last4":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}},"required":["amount"]}}
```
Send a 5-10 prompt validation set to Optimize so we can watch for regressions.

sec-bot: Compliance note 10: ask procurement to send vendor SOC2 questionnaire PDF to security@redwood.ai. Quick blockers: (1) dataflow diagram + ingestion points, (2) confirm whether raw utterances contain PII and retention policy, (3) if Dedicated requested include KMS/HSM details. Typical turnaround: 2-4 business days after we receive docs.

marta-ps: Pricing ask 11 4k QPS short bursts (2-6 minutes), ~5 bursts/day. Any ballpark guidance for Hosted vs Dedicated?

kevin-sales: For that pattern we usually propose either: (A) Hosted with negotiated burst credits (case-by-case), or (B) a small Dedicated reservation sized for peaks. Ballpark Dedicated slice for those peaks: $9k-18k/mo depending on GPU family and quantization. For the demo offer to run a short 1k QPS sim for 5 minutes to show perf.

sam-runtime: Operational checklist for demo:
- Provision ephemeral API key scoped to demo workspace (rotate every 10-15m)
- Enable enable_mux / transport_hint as needed and set trace:true
- Share expected payload size and max token length (we tune batching/window_ms)
- If they use SAML SSO, provide SP metadata and a test user ahead of time

marta-ps: Can someone produce a one-page runbook + two snippets (Python mux + curl fallback) by EOD today? I will forward their procurement contact and questionnaire when proc replies.

hana-devex: I can draft the runbook and include a tiny validator script and troubleshooting notes (header stripping, 401 on token expiry, CORS/proxy timeouts).

kevin-sales: I'll prepare a short pricing paragraph and an optional temporary Dedicated offer for the demo.

sec-bot: Confirmed 10 will triage SOC2 once we get the questionnaire and dataflow.

marta-ps: Thanks all 11 scheduling quick sync Mon 3pm PT to finalize materials?

sam-runtime: Works for me. :thumbsup:

hana-devex: Works. I'll drop calendar invite and attach draft runbook when ready.

kevin-sales: I'll join with pricing slides and notes for legal.

marta-ps: Great 10 I'm posting their initial payload shapes and QPS histogram in the channel now.
